name: University of Akron
tuition_note: uakron.edu is behind a JavaScript bot-challenge (HTTP 403 to WebFetch/curl), so figures are from NCES College Navigator (id 200800), corroborated by CollegeTuitionCompare, for the 2024-25 academic year: in-state tuition & fees $13,135; on-campus food & housing published only as a combined room+board figure of $11,904 (no room-only figure broken out).
